pre_c2_analyzer_ownership.summary: C1 established deterministic pre-parse ownership, but the analyzer response still represented broad semantic field state and could be read as a RetrievalPlan draft rather than an auditable semantic delta.

intent.pre_c2_behavior: Fixed deterministic intent is omitted from the analyzer schema; unresolved intent remains analyzer-owned.

target_repositories.pre_c2_behavior: Explicit deterministic repository references are retained while analyzer output can add semantic repository values.

concepts.pre_c2_behavior: Reviewed deterministic concepts and analyzer concepts are merged, but the analyzer field is not yet explicitly represented as additive semantic output.

symbols.pre_c2_behavior: Reviewed deterministic symbols and analyzer symbols are merged, with the remaining contract requiring explicit query grounding and non-invention.

requested_versions.pre_c2_behavior: Explicit repository-plus-version values are deterministic; unresolved analyzer version values remain semantic output and must not be invented or silently associated.

concept_scopes.pre_c2_behavior: Deterministic scope, analyzer scope, and fallback scope are merged with fixed > LLM > fallback precedence.

plan_draft_debt: Analyzer fields could be interpreted as complete authoritative field state instead of additive unresolved semantics.
Item-level query support and provenance were not yet the explicit contract for every analyzer semantic item.
The analyzer_unresolved_fields name did not clearly distinguish unresolved semantic inputs from final merged state.
A bare SHA could be confused with a repository-associated version when no repository was explicit in the question.
c1_debts_addressed_by_c2: Replace the plan-draft interpretation with AnalyzerSemanticDelta.
Require compact query-support and provenance for accepted analyzer items.
Separate version-token extraction from repository association, including bare-SHA unbound behavior.
Expose deterministic ownership, analyzer semantic output, and final merged state under unambiguous diagnostics names.

post_c2_semantic_delta_contract.authority: additive semantic information only; never an authoritative complete RetrievalPlan or replacement for deterministic pre-parse values

intent.semantics: Only emitted when deterministic intent is unresolved; classifies the requested operation, not an answer location.

repository_additions.semantics: Additive repository scope only when supported by the query or deterministic C1 context; never a corpus-derived guess.

concepts.semantics: Smallest useful query-grounded concepts; no answer hypotheses, source locations, or broad domain filler.

symbols.semantics: Exact technical identifiers from the query or reviewed deterministic context; no invented classes, functions, files, paths, branches, or macros.

version_mentions.shape: list of token mentions with optional repository association
version_mentions.semantics: Every token must occur in the query; explicit repository association is retained, otherwise the token remains unbound.

concept_scopes.semantics: Additive unresolved scope semantics merged below fixed deterministic scope and above fallback scope.

item_shape.support_spans: short exact substrings copied from the user question or explicitly supplied deterministic context

semantic_delta_field_shapes.version_mentions: uses its actual version-token field; repository association is represented separately and may remain unbound
semantic_delta_field_shapes.concept_scopes: uses its actual scope field; no extra per-item provenance field is implied

item_support_and_provenance.support_rule: Accepted semantic items must be traceable to the current query or deterministic C1 context, never to likely corpus contents.
item_support_and_provenance.item_provenance_rule: LLM ownership, accepted/rejected disposition, and deterministic provenance are recorded in enclosing diagnostics; the item itself does not carry an additional provenance field.
item_support_and_provenance.reasoning_storage: none; no reasoning, rationale, explanation, or chain-of-thought is requested or stored

ownership_merge.fixed: authoritative deterministic values and reviewed rule matches are not overwritten
ownership_merge.known_partial: deterministic values may be augmented by valid analyzer semantic additions
ownership_merge.unresolved: no deterministic value is available; the semantic delta may supply a grounded value
ownership_merge.fallback: used only when fixed and valid analyzer values are absent
ownership_merge.final_plan: constructed deterministically by application code after semantic-delta validation and merge

bare_sha_contract.bare_sha: preserve the exact token as an unbound version mention
bare_sha_contract.unsupported_association: must not bind a bare SHA to an analyzer-inferred repository
bare_sha_contract.version_conflict: evaluate conflicts only after the deterministic explicit-version merge; do not fabricate a conflict from unsupported association

deterministic_parse.fixed: deterministic authoritative values and fixed reviewed rules
deterministic_parse.known_partial: deterministic values that may receive additive semantic contributions
deterministic_parse.fallback: deterministic fallback values used after fixed and analyzer values
deterministic_parse.semantic_output_fields: semantic fields still requiring analyzer interpretation
deterministic_parse.unresolved_semantics: unresolved semantic inputs passed to the analyzer

required_sections.analyzer_semantic_output_fields: validated analyzer semantic output field names
required_sections.analyzer_raw_semantic_delta: raw AnalyzerSemanticDelta returned before accepted-item filtering
required_sections.analyzer_rejected_items: unsupported or invalid analyzer items rejected by contract validation
required_sections.analyzer_item_support: query support spans for analyzer semantic items
required_sections.unbound_version_tokens: exact version tokens with no explicit repository association
required_sections.analyzer_final: final analyzer-aware merged state and ownership diagnostics

analyzer_unresolved_fields.meaning: This runtime key is removed; unresolved semantic inputs and accepted analyzer output are represented by the exact runtime keys above.

t0_evidence.evidence_source: controller-supplied T0 evidence before live analyzer evaluation
t0_evidence.precondition_for_live_t2: T0 passed; the preregistered analyzer-only T2 set may be run later under the stated guardrails.
